jobs.occupation: Kitchen Help Industrial Kitchen - Aalter - 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or a perfectly cooked roast beef: you’ll be licking your fingers and thumbs. And in this role, you’ll make sure others can do the same. In our kitchen, we create dishes that would make grandmothers jealous—but on an industrial scale, in large quantities.

We’re looking for a Kitchen Help for a food company in Aalter!

Hygiene is crucial for a kitchen staff member. That’s why you’ll ensure every day that your work methods and the final products meet all standards.

You’ll also follow safety regulations to the letter. You’ll do everything in your power to guarantee both quality and safety. 

Who are you?

• You have experience as a cook in a commercial or industrial kitchen. Do you also have experience in a production environment? If so, that’s a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system.
• The early shift starts at 4:30 a.m. and runs until 12:30 p.m.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 p.m. and runs until 8:00 p.m. 
• You know how to operate machinery or are willing to undergo training for this.
• Physical work doesn’t deter you, and you’re hands-on.
• You work with great precision and are flexible and able to handle stress.
• You’re a good communicator, enjoy variety, and like working in a team.
• You speak Dutch or English well.

In our kitchen, we produce preparations that would make grandmothers jealous, but on an industrial scale and in large quantities.

We are looking for a Cook in the Aalter region! 
What are your responsibilities? 
• Hygiene is essential for any kitchen employee. That is why you ensure every day that your working methods and finished products comply with all applicable standards.
• You strictly follow all safety regulations. You do everything possible to guarantee both quality and safety. 

Who are you?
• You have experience as a cook in a large-scale catering kitchen or an industrial kitchen. Experience in a production environment is a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system. 
• The early shift starts at 4:30 AM and ends at 12:30 PM.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 PM and ends at 8:00 PM.

jobs.occupation: Business Analyst MS Dynamics 365 (ERP) Finance & Operations
jobs.description:
Are you a Business Analyst with experience in MS Dynamics 365 (ERP) Finance & Operations? Do you see yourself as the bridge between business and IT, with a strong focus on both processes and people? Then keep reading, because you might be exactly the person we're looking for! As an ERP Business Analyst, you play a key role in understanding and translating business needs into effective solutions.

 

• You take the lead in identifying and defining business needs.
• You advise on which improvements create the greatest value by analysing business context, high-level requirements and ROI.
• You provide business cases to support Business Partners and Project Managers in defining roadmaps and initiating projects.
• Together with the Application Architect, you define high-level solutions that contribute maximally to business objectives.
• You document your analyses clearly and accurately, using appropriate business analysis techniques.
• You manage priorities and facilitate collaboration between stakeholders and technical teams.
• You work closely with business stakeholders, solution architects and external partners.
• You support business stakeholders in decision-making and provide insights to maximise ROI.
• You are responsible for monitoring and safeguarding the achievement of initial objectives throughout project delivery.
• You are able to prioritise business needs across multiple stakeholders and domains.
What you need to succeed:
• You hold a higher education degree (preferably a Master's degree) and have at least 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst.
• You enjoy acting as the bridge between business and IT.
• With strong analytical skills, you work in a structured, results-oriented manner.
• You are a team player, but you are equally comfortable working independently.
• You have a hands-on mindset and enjoy tackling complex challenges.
• You have experience with tools and systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Office tools), Confluence, Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) and Jira.
• Experience and knowledge within Procurement are a plus.
• You are familiar with Agile methodologies, ITIL processes and BPMN modelling.
• You communicate fluently in both Dutch and English.
• You work from our Hasselt (Corda Campus) office at least one day per week, combined with remote working.

Do you have a proven track record when it comes to succesfully realizing CRM implementations as a Project Manager? Do you ensure that your customers' projects are implemented within the agreed scope, budget and time? Do you also have functional skills? And are you looking for a new challenge? Then join our Customer Engagement team and work on innovative projects for our customers, using the various technologies in the Microsoft Dynamics 365 stack. Our team consists of 50 passionate and motivated colleagues, each with different areas of expertise. We are part of the Cegeka Business Solutions Belgium, which consists of +- 280 consultants. In addition to Microsoft Gold Partner status and the Inner Circle Label, we were named Western Europe Partner of the Year in the Business Applications Cloud category in 2023, and Microsoft Partner of The Year in Belgium in 2024. We therefore work very closely with Microsoft for knowledge sharing and growth. Would you like to help build our growth story?

 

• As Project Manager, you will be responsible for the implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement projects at our customers. This primarily involves delivering the entire project within the agreed scope, budget and time. 
• You monitor and report on all aspects of the project so that it meets organisational requirements, methodology and quality standards.
• You are the primary point of contact for the customer. You translate expectations into a project plan with clear objectives that are approved by the steering committee.
• You organise the project kick-off, ensuring that all employees and stakeholders are informed and aligned with the project plan.
• During the duration of the project, you motivate and guide the project team towards the objectives to be achieved. You do this through regular project evaluations and feedback interviews.
• You advise the customer throughout the implementation process and take the lead in internal and external project meetings.
• You identify and manage project risks, bottlenecks and changes.
• You constantly update the project plan, keeping it ‘up to date’. You consistently apply Cegeka's project methodology.
What you need to succeed:
• You have a proven track record as a Project Manager in achieving CRM implementations. Knowledge of Dynamics CRM/D365 Customer Engagement is a big plus.
• You have a good knowledge of the functional and technical specifications involved in CRM implementation projects.
• Through your expert knowledge, your flair, your flexibility and your commitment, you succeed in winning our customers' trust.
• To manage your team, you have excellent leadership and communication skills.
• You have an excellent knowledge of Dutch and English.
• Being certified in at least one project methodology such as Prince2 or PMBOK is a plus.
• You immediately feel at home in Cegeka's result-oriented, no-nonsense approach.

Are you looking for a full-time day-shift job in a production environment in the Tielt area? In this role, you’ll support the flow of goods involved in manufacturing windows and doors.

A metalworking production environment

You’ll join a workplace where metal windows and doors are made.

What you’ll do:

• 
Receive, inspect, and store goods and materials.

• 
Load windows and doors onto racks and gather materials for production.

• 
Move windows, doors, and components within the facility, and help with loading and unloading.

• 
Inspect finished products and prepare them for shipping.

• 
Keep the warehouse and work areas organized, track the flow of goods, and step in where needed.

Do you thrive when you can roll up your sleeves and work alongside colleagues to get things done? Then you may recognize yourself in this profile.

• 
You’re someone who sees what needs to be done and likes to pitch in.

• 
You’re comfortable with physical work, and it doesn’t hold you back from staying active.

• 
You approach your work with accuracy and a strong sense of responsibility.

• 
Your positive attitude helps you contribute to a great team environment.

• 
You have a good command of Dutch or English.

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager & Business Analyst – Passenger Information Systems
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Define the global target vision for dynamic traveler information systems, including lifecycle and maintenance analysis.
• Perform economic evaluations using TCO and CAPEX/OPEX models to support multi-year investment roadmaps.
• Translate strategic objectives into business cases, decision files, and technical specifications for procurement.
• Lead the cloud migration of information systems by defining target architectures in collaboration with IT and security experts.
• Coordinate cross-functional teams including vendors, business stakeholders, and infrastructure departments.
• Manage testing, cut-over strategies, and post-migration stabilization to ensure service continuity.
• Establish operational frameworks, including SLAs, KPIs, and service management processes.

Requirements

• 8+ years in IT Project Management and Business Analysis within complex, large-scale environments.
• 5+ years in Asset & Lifecycle Management, including obsolescence analysis and Capacity Planning.
• 3+ years of experience leading Cloud Migration projects and Dependency Management.
• Experience with Application Integration and defining target architectures for hardware-software systems.
• Proven expertise in Budget Management and Supplier Relationship Management, including contract negotiations.
• Proficiency in drafting Business Cases and technical specifications for public tenders or formal procurement processes.
• Knowledge of ServiceNow for monitoring and service management.
• Proactive and solution-oriented with excellent executive reporting and stakeholder management skills.
• You are fluent in French and Dutch with professional proficiency in English.
Nice to Haves

• Certifications in Project Management (e.g., PRINCE2, PMP) or Agile methodologies.
• Professional experience within the public transport or mobility sector.
• Knowledge of Security, IAM, or GDPR requirements in a cloud context.

jobs.occupation: Service Delivery Director | BENELUX | Industry Finance
jobs.description:
As Industry Delivery Director Financial Services, you take overall responsibility for the successful delivery of services and solutions across a strategic portfolio of banking and insurance clients. You work alongside the Client Director, combining commercial ambitions with a delivery organization that performs reliably, efficiently and at scale. You are the senior delivery counterpart for our clients and ensure that commitments made by Cegeka translate into successful outcomes. You connect client expectations with Cegeka's delivery capabilities across service lines, countries and our Global Delivery Network.

 

• You take overall responsibility for delivery performance across a strategic portfolio of Financial Services clients, ensuring that services and projects are delivered according to agreed quality, scope, timelines and commitments.
• You act as a senior delivery partner to the Client Director and the client, bringing a delivery perspective into strategic account discussions and ensuring that commercial ambitions can be translated into sustainable and scalable delivery.
• You build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and act as an executive escalation point for critical delivery matters. You create transparency, take ownership when challenges arise and ensure that the right stakeholders are mobilized to resolve them.
• You establish and maintain strong delivery governance across the client portfolio, with clear accountability, decision-making, KPIs, service levels, risk management and escalation mechanisms. Strong governance, transparency and clear roles are particularly important when delivery spans multiple teams and locations. [Kennismaking Cegeka | Meeting]
• You continuously monitor delivery performance and identify opportunities to improve quality, customer satisfaction, operational efficiency and cost to serve. In Cegeka's new operating model, these delivery measures are distinct from the Client Director's P&L and growth accountability. [Short brie...assessment | Teams]
• You connect the different parts of Cegeka needed to deliver successfully, working across Service Lines, Industries, countries and the Global Delivery Network. You make sure that delivery functions as one organization towards the client rather than as separate teams or locations. [HR BE - ch...in - LEAP | Meeting]
• You help define the right delivery and resource model for your clients, balancing local, nearshore and offshore capabilities and ensuring that the right expertise is available at the right time. Cegeka is increasingly organizing delivery across locations including Belgium, Romania, Greece, India and Colombia. [Kennismaking Cegeka | Meeting]
• You anticipate operational and delivery risks and take action before they impact the client. When delivery performance comes under pressure, you bring structure to the situation, establish clear priorities and lead recovery or transformation initiatives.
• You contribute to major pursuits and transitions by ensuring that proposed solutions are deliverable, scalable and operationally sustainable. You provide delivery input into resource models, governance, transition plans, risks and commitments before major engagements are signed.
• You lead and develop senior delivery professionals and create an environment of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement. Depending on the final organizational setup, the role may include both functional and hierarchical leadership. Cegeka's existing executive delivery profile is classified as both functional and hierarchical coordination. [Executive...ry Manager | Word]
• You help further professionalize Cegeka's delivery organization by building scalable ways of working, strengthening governance and sharing best practices across clients and countries.
What you need to succeed:
• You have at least 15 years of relevant professional experience, including significant experience in senior service delivery, IT operations, managed services, outsourcing, transformation or program leadership.
• You have successfully led complex, business-critical IT delivery environments, ideally covering multiple technologies, teams, suppliers and countries.
• You have experience managing large-scale delivery in areas such as managed services, application services, cloud/infrastructure, security, data or digital transformation. Breadth is more important than being the deepest technical expert in one specific area.
• You understand the dynamics of Financial Services and are comfortable operating in highly regulated, business-critical environments where resilience, security, compliance and service continuity matter.
• You have a strong understanding of delivery economics and can balance customer commitments, quality, capacity, productivity, risk and cost.
• You have extensive experience with governance, SLA/KPI management, executive reporting, risk management and escalations, and you know how to turn complex delivery issues into clear decisions and actions.
• You have experience working with distributed and international delivery models, including combinations of local, nearshore, offshore and partner resources.
• You are comfortable operating at C-level and senior management level, both internally and with clients. You can challenge constructively, communicate transparently when delivery is under pressure and build trust through ownership and follow-through.
• You are a strong people leader who can bring different teams together, provide direction to senior professionals and create accountability without becoming involved in every operational detail.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English. Knowledge of French is a strong asset.
• You are based in Belgium and are comfortable working in a hybrid environment, with regular presence at Cegeka offices and client locations.

Do you combine compliance assurance expertise with the ability to turn control failures, audit findings and regulatory requirements into decisive action? Join our Cyber Resilience & Assurance team and help Cegeka and its customers achieve sustained compliance, stronger audit readiness and transparent risk management. 

• Lead the compliance-assurance cycle for assigned customers, including regulatory applicability, control assessment, evidence readiness, deficiency management and remediation follow-up.
• Apply and continuously improve Cegeka’s multi-compliance framework, common control set, evidence model and testing approach.
• Maintain complete customer-specific views of the central backlog, linking control failures to business impact, accountable owners, mitigation actions, deadlines, status and closure evidence.
• Prepare and lead monthly customer assurance reporting and meetings, highlighting material changes, customer-owned actions, audit readiness, decisions and escalations.
• Challenge Cegeka and customer stakeholders, agree risk-based deadlines and verifiable evidence, and escalate material non-compliance, missed commitments and residual risk through the defined governance path.
• Support ISAE assurance for in-scope customers and coordinate with the Global Compliance Office, auditors, Service Delivery Managers, Control Owners and Technical Owners.
• Protect assurance quality, professional judgement, traceability and appropriate independence between advisory support and assurance.
• Contribute expertise to selected strategic opportunities and develop reusable services, templates, tooling, automation and industry-specific propositions. 
What you need to succeed:
• Substantial experience in information-security assurance, technology risk, compliance or GRC, with end-to-end ownership of findings, evidence validation, stakeholder communication and escalation.
• Strong knowledge of frameworks and standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, COBIT and SOC 2, plus practical experience with multi-compliance frameworks and ISAE or comparable service-organisation assurance.
• The ability to interpret control results, assess customer impact and urgency, select the right follow-up route and present clear, defensible conclusions.
• Experience engaging senior customer stakeholders, auditors, regulators or supervisory functions and translating requirements into pragmatic remediation.
• A disciplined consulting mindset, professional scepticism and strong judgement, communication, influence and constructive-challenge skills.
• Experience in regulated industries and multi-country or cross-functional environments is strongly preferred.
• Relevant higher education or equivalent professional experience; certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CISM or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Lead Implementer are an advantage.
• Excellent written and spoken English; additional languages relevant to assigned markets are an asset.

Do you combine deep Microsoft security expertise with architectural judgement to turn complex requirements into secure, scalable and supportable solutions? As Security Solution Architect – Microsoft Security, part of our Security & Networking Architecture team, you are a senior, customer-facing technical authority for the Microsoft security domain. You own solution architecture and design authority from discovery through delivery, translating business, risk and security requirements into integrated architectures across Microsoft 365, Azure and hybrid environments. Your scope spans Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Purview. You collaborate closely with the Cegeka Modern SOC, which supports the Microsoft security stack. You work directly on customer engagements and provide specialist architecture expertise to opportunities led by the Solution Pre-Sales team.

 

• You lead customer discovery, architecture workshops and technical decision forums to assess Microsoft security maturity and clarify requirements, constraints, dependencies and risks.
• Design integrated Zero Trust architectures using Microsoft Entra, Defender, Sentinel and Purview, with Intune and Azure networking controls where relevant.
• Act as design authority for Microsoft security solutions: define high-level designs, integration patterns and security standards; review solution artefacts; and govern exceptions, technical debt and architectural trade-offs.
• Guide engineering and project teams through implementation and migration. Validate detailed designs, configuration baselines and runbooks. Agree onboarding and acceptance criteria with the Cegeka Modern SOC, including detection and response workflows, access and escalation paths, and confirm readiness for operational handover.
• Address security, integration and operational risks through least privilege, identity governance, segmentation, data protection and resilience. Define telemetry, automation and integration requirements with the Cegeka Modern SOC across Microsoft and third-party platforms, with clear ownership of control management and incident response.
• Provide validated Microsoft security architecture inputs to the Solution Pre-Sales team, including solution options, licensing prerequisites, consumption and delivery estimates, assumptions, dependencies and risks.
• Partner with Product Management and the Cegeka Modern SOC to evolve Microsoft security services, reference architectures, blueprints and costing models. Use operational feedback and incident lessons to improve designs and translate platform developments into supportable customer propositions.
• Maintain reusable Microsoft security architecture assets, coach colleagues and contribute to Microsoft technology-partner relationships. Evaluate emerging capabilities, including AI security, against customer needs and operational constraints.
What you need to succeed:
• Substantial experience designing and delivering enterprise Microsoft security solutions, with senior-level architectural credibility and the ability to lead customer-facing technical discussions.
• Deep hands-on expertise in at least one Microsoft security pillar—Entra identity and access, Defender threat protection, Sentinel security operations, Defender for Cloud, or Purview data security—with architectural understanding across the wider portfolio.
• Strong understanding of Microsoft 365, Azure, endpoint management with Intune, networking and workload security, including integration with non-Microsoft technologies.
• Experience collaborating with SOC and managed services teams on monitoring, response, onboarding and operational handover.
• Demonstrated ability to translate requirements into integrated high-level designs, govern technical decisions and review detailed designs, migration plans, security baselines and operational documentation. Practical familiarity with KQL, PowerShell or infrastructure-as-code is an asset.
• Experience supporting dedicated presales teams with Microsoft security solution options, licensing and consumption considerations, effort and cost inputs, dependencies and risks.
• You can explain technical trade-offs to both technical and business stakeholders.
• Strong architectural thinking, technical leadership, consulting, communication and collaboration skills. You balance Microsoft platform capabilities with customer risk, existing investments, commercial constraints and supportability.
• Excellent written and spoken English; additional languages are an asset.
• Microsoft security certifications or equivalent demonstrable expertise.
• Relevant higher education or equivalent professional experience in cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, infrastructure or architecture.

jobs.occupation: Internship - Procurement Digital Transformation, AI & Sustainability
jobs.description:
About Agfa

At Agfa, Procurement plays a key role in driving digitalization, innovative technologies adoption, sustainability advancing, and operational excellence across a global organization. As part of our Procurement Process Office, you will contribute to strategic initiatives that help modernize procurement processes and improve decision-making to create business value. You will also support sustainability activities, category management and other procurement projects across our global teams.  

This role offers a unique opportunity to gain practical experience in AI, digital transformation, sustainability and overall, the procurement function.

About the role

We are looking for a motivated and technology-minded student to join our Procurement Process Office. You will be supporting AI and automation projects for Procurement, sustainability initiatives and general procurement tasks across our global teams.

Your responsibilities
 
• Support the development of AI-enabled procurement solutions, including Copilot agents, automation initiatives and other practical use cases. 
• Help identify and assess new AI opportunities by understanding business needs, gathering requirements and translating them into clear project ideas. 
• Analyse data and prepare insights, dashboards and presentations to support project decisions and communicate results. 
• Contribute to procurement sustainability activities, such as carbon footprint measurement, reporting and supplier risk assessments. 
• Support procurement category initiatives across our global teams. 

Your profile

You are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in on of the following areas:
 
• Business Engineering  
• Business Administration 
• Economics 
• Supply Chain Management 
• Data Analytics 
• Industrial Engineering 
• Or a related discipline 
In addition, you:
 
• Have a strong interest in AI, digital technologies and their practical use in business. 
• Are curious about procurement and interested in learning how purchasing processes work in practice in a global organization. 
• Are comfortable working with Copilot, Excel and other Microsoft Office tools. 
• Have a strong analytical and problem-solving mindset. 
• Work in a structured, proactive and independent way. 
• Communicate effectively in English, both written and spoken. 
• Are eager to learn, experiment and contribute in a collaborative environment. 
Preferred qualifications

Experience with one or more of the following is considered an asset:
 
• AI tools or automation platforms 
• Power BI or other data visualization tools  
• Process improvement methodologies  
• Sustainability, and CSRD-related topics

Are you a natural hunter with a passion for both technology and commerce? In this role, you’ll combine strategic business development with technical insight to identify, approach, and win new clients. You’ll be responsible for expanding our customer portfolio by actively seeking out new business opportunities in the market and this for Cegeka’s Cloud & Digital Platform Business Line.

 

• You prospect for new customer logos.
• You position our Cloud portfolio with existing clients.
• You build strong relationships with prospects and key stakeholders.
• You identify market needs and translate them into tailored technical solutions.
• You prepare commercial proposals and present them in close collaboration with the technical team.
• You work closely with Marketing to create and refine the value proposition and sales story.
• You contribute to the company’s strategic growth by exploring new markets and collaborating closely with other business lines.
• You work together with key vendors (such as Microsoft, IBM, Dynatrace, etc.) to develop joint sales plans, defining which customers to target and with which offerings.
What you need to succeed:
• You have a strong commercial drive and proven experience in generating new business.
• You have a technical background in Cloud and digital platform products & services.
• You are an excellent communicator with strong persuasive skills.
• You are entrepreneurial and results-driven.
• You are fluent in spoken and written Dutch and English. Knowledge of French is a plus.
• Knowledge of, or established relationships with vendors is essential.
• Certifications are a plus.
• You work from a Cegeka location of your choice, at client and prospect sites in Belgium and from home.

Are you an experienced Functional Analyst who enjoys working in a Scrum environment and are you eager to immerse yourself in a complex, long-term project? Do you also possess strong communication skills in Dutch, English, and a bit of French? Then we are looking for you! Within our Social Impact division, we are launching a new greenfield project for one of our clients active in pension fund management; think of complex calculations, no margin for error, etc. To help ensure the success of this project, we are looking for an experienced Functional Analyst to join our team. Are you ready to strengthen our team and contribute to a project that delivers real societal value?

• You capture and analyze business requirements and translate them into clear and actionable user stories.
• You act as the go-to person for questions related to analyses, developed user stories, customer requests, and development activities.
• You closely monitor the development process and are responsible for testing and validating delivered functionality. You also support and guide the customer during user acceptance testing.
• Shaping Digital Together: you collaborate closely with various stakeholders in a Scrum environment that works in two-week sprints. You actively participate in daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
What you need to succeed:
• You have several years of experience as a Functional Analyst within an Agile/Scrum environment and understand how to deliver value through iterative development.
• Experience in environments involving complex calculations related to pensions, insurance, or financial products is considered a strong asset.
• You have experience with backlog management, refinement sessions, and prioritizing work items.
• You communicate effectively with both business stakeholders and technical teams, acting as a bridge between the two worlds. You are fluent in Dutch and English, and you are comfortable communicating in French as well.
• You are familiar with analysis techniques and tools such as UML, BPMN, wireframing, and user story mapping.
• You have a genuine interest in AI and actively explore opportunities to leverage new technologies to work more efficiently and effectively.
• You possess strong analytical skills, think in a solution-oriented manner, and can translate complex challenges into pragmatic solutions.
• You are proactive, take ownership, and are not afraid to take initiative within the team.
• You work in a structured way, keeping scope, quality, and priorities under control in a dynamic environment.
• Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps is considered a plus.
